description: Open a versioned composition as a running React/Vue app with recorded measurements. Use it when reviewing generated behavior or edits; use fidelity_preview instead for static diagrams, wireframes or mockups. Returns preview URLs, composition lineage, editable fields and measured/notMeasured evidence. Supply compositionId/version or object/context; action selects render, edit, compare or versions. Edits create a new version. framework and preferences select rendering; contextItems attach fetched evidence. runPath selects captured-run records, analysisPath selects derived comparisons, and recordId chooses an exact record. Writes version artifacts and measurements; domain actions still require consumer integration. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#design_preview; full schema: oods://schemas/design_preview.input.json.

action.description: render (default): open the version as the running app. See full schema for details.

against.description: action compare: the version on the right; the left is compositionId@version.

compositionId.description: The other composition; default the same composition.

analysisPath.description: Portable Stage1 derived-analysis directory. Composes Comparison or ComparisonSignal from attested retained bytes, separate from runPath. Only read-only contexts; recordId selects an exact signal.

compositionId.description: An existing composition from design.compose; with no version, its latest version opens.

context.description: View context for object-aware composition. See full schema for details.

contextItems.description: Decisions and evidence about this object that YOU already fetched, shown beside the running preview and stored on the version. See full schema for details.

items.description: context Items item. Fields: source, id, title, body, excerpt, url, timestamp, query, fetchedAt, object, urn. See full schema.

contextSearched.description: What you searched that returned nothing, so an empty panel is a statement rather than a silence: the reader can tell 'nothing was found' from 'nobody asked'.

items.description: context Searched item. Fields: source, query, fetchedAt, found. See full schema.

edit.description: action edit: the one operation to apply to compositionId@version. The parent version is never changed.

component.description: swap-slot: one of the composer's own candidates for that slot on the parent version (the… See full schema for details.

fieldOrder.description: reorder-fields: the region's field names in the desired order.

regionOrder.description: reorder-region: the screen's region ids in the desired order (the version record lists them).

framework.description: Which generated app to compile and serve; both frameworks by default, each at its own URL.

object.description: Object name from the OODS registry (e.g., 'Subscription', 'User'); with context, composes a new composition (version 1) and opens it.

observationRunPath.description: A Stage1 run directory on this machine (out/stage1/<suite>/<run-uuid>). See full schema for details.

brand.description: Brand the page mounts with (data-brand and the matching token CSS scope).

fieldGroups.description: Number of field groups for form layout.

metricColumns.description: Number of metric columns for dashboard layout.

tabCount.description: Number of tabs for detail layout.

tabLabels.description: Custom tab labels for detail layout.

theme.description: Theme the page mounts with (data-theme and the matching token CSS scope).

presentation.description: Named Stage1 inspection presentation: omit the accessibility score and prominently show measurement limits. Source records remain unchanged.

recordId.description: Exact record ID for a fresh runPath or analysisPath detail/card/inline view. Unknown IDs refuse before composition; existing versions retain their selected record.

runPath.description: A Stage1 run directory on this machine (out/stage1/<suite>/<run-uuid>) whose REAL records this version shows: the run itself for Run, its findings for Finding, its attested artifacts for CapturedArtifact. See full schema for details.

version.description: The version of compositionId to open.

name: design_preview
title: Preview Running Design
